title: TripStay Goa
hero.subtitle: A full property stay, documented — check-in to closing frame.

headline: The Brief
paragraphs: TripStay brought this work on to document a full stay at their Goa property — content built to cover the property itself, room by room, rather than a single highlight reel.

The brief covered check-in through checkout: bedrooms, living areas, kitchen, bathrooms, balcony views, the pool, amenities and the surrounding neighbourhood — shot to be genuinely usable across TripStay's own Instagram, Facebook, website, ads, brochures and WhatsApp marketing.

headline: Creative Direction
paragraphs: Rather than a single polished reel, the direction called for full coverage — a cinematic walkthrough of every room, lifestyle shots of the amenities and surroundings, and both a morning and evening read of the same spaces.
Video was shot in LOG rather than a baked-in look, so the footage could carry a considered cinematic grade in the final edit and still remain flexible for TripStay's own future use.

headline: The Story
paragraphs: The film and photo set follow one genuine stay through the property — check-in, the rooms, the pool, the view, the ambiance of morning and evening — built to read as a real stay rather than a listing shoot.

headline: Production
paragraphs: Shot and edited solo on location, built around full coverage of the property rather than a single hero angle — interiors, the pool, the view, and the property's morning and evening character.
Raw video was recorded in LOG. Custom LUTs built for the final cinematic grade were delivered alongside the raw footage, so TripStay can re-cut the material themselves.

headline: Deliverables
items: 1 edited Instagram Reel — full stay experience
Instagram Story files from the stay
15–20 raw video clips, captured in LOG, including both vertical and horizontal footage
LOG → final colour grading LUTs, delivered for TripStay's own use
